subject: gk
question: Which of the following CANNOT be grouped under physiographic divisions of India?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Appalachian Mountains.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Appalachian Mountains were formed during the **Paleozoic era.**
 
• The Appalachian Mountains are situated in** eastern North America**.
 
• The Appalachians f**irst formed during the Ordovician Period** roughly around 480 million years ago.
